entries.meaning_mt: Persuna tajba, ġeneruża u li tgħin lill-oħrajn.
entries.meaning_en: A kind, generous person who helps others.
entries.example: Marija dejjem tgħin lil kulħadd. Għandha qalbha tad-deheb.
Qiegħed fuq ix-xwiek sakemm joħorġu r-riżultati.
Ma tistax tikkonvinċih, għandu rasu iebsa.

entries.meaning_mt: Mhux dak kollu li jidher sabiħ huwa tajjeb.
entries.meaning_en: All that glitters is not gold.
entries.example: Oqgħod attent b'dik l-offerta. Mhux kull ma jleqq deheb.

entries.meaning_mt: Aħjar tagħmel xi ħaġa tard milli xejn.
entries.example: Wasalt fl-aħħar, imma aħjar tard milli qatt.
Ħadt il-ktieb. Nieħu l-kafè kull filgħodu. Ħu din!

entries.meaning_en: The verb 'to go out' in Maltese.
The verb 'to come in' in Maltese.
The verb 'to be enough' in Maltese.

entries.example: Jien Malti. Int minn fejn int?

entries.meaning_mt: L-artiklu definit. Quddiem vokali jsir l-.
entries.meaning_en: The definite article. Before a vowel: l-.

entries.meaning_mt: Quddiem ittri xemxin, l-artiklu jieħu l-ittra ta' warajh.
entries.meaning_en: Before sun letters the article copies the next letter.

entries.meaning_mt: Għ tinkiteb b'żewġ ittri imma hija ittra waħda.
entries.meaning_en: Għ is two characters but one letter.

entries.meaning_mt: Ħ tinstema'. H waħedha ġeneralment ma tinstemax.
entries.meaning_en: Ħ is sounded. Plain h is usually silent.
